Import.TheRestNameEveryChangeToo.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !ImportCommand.isAnyOf(["TakeBackImport", "ReopenImport", "RemoveImport"])(command) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        command.seen === before.changes

Import.EveryChangeHasItsOwnNumber.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(after) ||
        after.changes === before.changes + (ImportCommand.guards.RecordSuggestion(command) ? 0 : 1)

Import.OnlyAnImportWithAConfirmStandingI.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !ImportCommand.guards.TakeBackImport(command) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        before.standing >= 1

Import.ATakeBackIsOfEverythingInForce.source:
({ before, after, command, events }) =>
        !ImportCommand.guards.TakeBackImport(command) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(after) ||
        (after.standing === 0 &&
          after.replaced === 0 &&
          after.inForce === command.kept &&
          A.every(events, (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ImportTakenBack(e) || e.removed + e.kept === before.inForce))

Import.AndOfEverythingReplaced.source:
({ before, command, events }) =>
        !ImportCommand.guards.TakeBackImport(command) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ImportTakenBack(e) || e.restored + e.keptReplaced === before.replaced
        )

Import.ASuggestionWritesNothing.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !ImportCommand.guards.RecordSuggestion(command) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(before) ||
        (ImportState.guards.Open(after) && after.matching === before.matching && after.changes === before.changes)

Import.AnImportIsOpenedAgainOnlyByReopen.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !ImportState.guards.Open(after) ||
        ImportState.guards.Open(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        (ImportCommand.guards.ReopenImport(command) &&
          (ImportState.guards.Imported(before) || ImportState.guards.TakenBack(before)))

Import.AnImportNeverChangesOrganization.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        before.organizationId === after.organizationId

Row.ARowNeverChangesImportOrOrganization.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        RowState.guards.Untouched(before) ||
        RowState.guards.Untouched(after) ||
        (before.organizationId === after.organizationId && before.importId === after.importId)

Group.AGroupNeverChangesImportOrOrganiza.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        GroupState.guards.Untouched(before) ||
        GroupState.guards.Untouched(after) ||
        (before.organizationId === after.organizationId && before.importId === after.importId)

DecideRow.ADecisionIsReplacedOnlyByAnAct.source: ({ before, command }) => sawIt({ row: before.row, command })

DecideRow.AnActThatChangesNothingLeavesT.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(before.life) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(after.life) ||
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes

({ before, after, command }) =>
        !changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.change === before.row.change

DecideRow.AnyOtherActIsRecorded.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) || RowState.guards.Decided(after.row)

DecideRow.WithItsText.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.flags === command.flags

DecideRow.OnItsMatching.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.madeOn === command.madeOn

DecideRow.UnderItsStep.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.step === command.step

DecideRow.AndGetsTheNextNumber.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(before.life) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(after.life) ||
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

DecideRow.OnTheRowToo.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !ImportState.guards.Open(after.life) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.change === after.life.changes

DecideRow.TheImportsEventSaysWhichDecisi.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) =>
            !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) || e.holds === after.row.change
        )

DecideRow.TheImportsEventSaysWhose.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) || e.by === after.row.by
        )

DecideRow.TheImportsEventSaysItsText.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) || e.flags === after.row.flags
        )

DecideRow.AnActKeepsWhichDecisionItRepla.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.change === before.row.change

DecideRow.AndWhose.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.by === before.row.by

DecideRow.AndItsText.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.flags === before.row.flags

DecideRow.AndItsMatching.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.under.madeOn === before.row.madeOn

DecideRow.AndWhatWasBelowStaysBelow.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        changesNothing({ row: before.row, command }) ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        after.row.below ===
          (before.row.under.change === 0
            ? ""
            : before.row.below.length > MOST_BELOW
              ? CUT
              : seal({ level: before.row.under, below: before.row.below }))

UndoRowStep.WhatLiesUnderIsWhatWasRecord.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        !RowState.guards.Decided(before.row) ||
        before.row.under.change === 0 ||
        !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ||
        (before.row.below === ""
          ? after.row.under.change === 0
          : before.row.below === CUT
            ? after.row.under.change === -1
            : seal({ level: after.row.under, below: after.row.below }) === before.row.below)

UndoRowStep.TheImportsEventSaysWhichDeci.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) =>
            !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || e.holds === (RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) ? after.row.change : 0)
        )

UndoRowStep.TheImportsEventSaysWhose.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) || e.by === after.row.by
        )

UndoRowStep.TheImportsEventSaysItsText.source:
({ after, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) => !ImportEvent.guards.ActCounted(e) || !RowState.guards.Decided(after.row) || e.flags === after.row.flags
        )

UndoRowStep.AnUndoIsNumbered.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        ImportState.guards.Open(before.life) &&
        ImportState.guards.Open(after.life) &&
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

UndoGroup.AGroupsUndoIsOneChange.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        ImportState.guards.Open(before.life) &&
        ImportState.guards.Open(after.life) &&
        after.life.changes === before.life.changes + 1

UndoGroup.TheImportsEventSaysHowManyRows.source:
({ before, events }) =>
        A.every(
          events,
          (e) =>
            !ImportEvent.guards.GroupCounted(e) ||
            !GroupState.guards.Decided(before.group) ||
            e.rows === before.group.count
        )

Catalog.NoRowAndGroupHoldTheSameChange.source:
(all) =>
        A.every(all.Row, (row) =>
          everyDecidedGroup(
            all.Group,
            (group) =>
              !RowState.guards.Decided(row.state) ||
              row.state.importId !== group.importId ||
              (row.state.change !== group.change && row.state.change !== group.undoneAt)
          )
        )

Catalog.AGroupsChangeIsOneItsImportGave.source:
(all) =>
        everyGroupOfItsImport(
          all,
          (group, life) => group.change >= 1 && group.change <= life.changes && group.undoneAt <= life.changes
        )

Catalog.NoGroupActIsLaterThanTheImportsL.source:
(all) =>
        everyGroupOfItsImport(all, (group, life) => group.change <= life.lastGroup && group.undoneAt <= life.lastGroup)

Catalog.ARowBelongsToItsImportsOrganizat.source:
({ life, row }) =>
          RowState.guards.Untouched(row.state) ||
          row.state.importId !== life.id ||
          (!ImportState.guards.Unstaged(life.state) && row.state.organizationId === life.state.organizationId)

Catalog.AGroupBelongsToItsImportsOrganiz.source:
({ life, group }) =>
          GroupState.guards.Untouched(group.state) ||
          group.state.importId !== life.id ||
          (!ImportState.guards.Unstaged(life.state) && group.state.organizationId === life.state.organizationId)

Import.AConfirmLeavesAClosedImportsStatu.source:
({ before, after, command }) =>
        !ImportCommand.guards.ConfirmImport(command) ||
        ImportState.guards.Open(before) ||
        after.status === before.status

Import.TheMatchingMovesOnlyOnAnOpenImpor.source:
({ before, after }) =>
        ImportState.guards.Open(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(before) ||
        ImportState.guards.Removed(after) ||
        ImportState.guards.Unstaged(after) ||
        after.matching === before.matching
